description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableMeasurement class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It verifies immutability, equals/hashCode, and JSON serialization/deserialization behaviors.

classes.name: ImmutableMeasurementTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ImmutableMeasurement class, focusing on immutability, equality, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableMeasurement correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableMeasurement is immutable and that MetricType is also immutable.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method of ImmutableMeasurement returns the expected JSON object.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the fromJson static method correctly reconstructs an ImmutableMeasurement from JSON.
